summary: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Note Purchase Agreement for a $809,705.75 convertible promissory note with Defender Opportunity LLC. Proceeds extinguished $720,000 principal and $89,705.75 interest on original notes held by insiders Dr. Jane Hsaio and Dr. Phillip Frost affiliates. The note carries 11% interest (22% after Nov 12) due Dec 31, 2026, convertible at $0.01966/share, with automatic conversion upon closing of a previously announced merger with Gravitics, Inc. This is routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; the merger is already disclosed.
